newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - July 3.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Nearly 30,000 tons of food and other items valued at 1.3 billion rupees sent to the north by ship and road in the past three months, say M.I.M. Rafeek, Commissioner General of Essential Services.
Nine soldiers to be tried in Colombo High Court for unlawful abduction and murder of a teenage Tamil student, her mother, brother and a neighbour in northern Jaffna in September 1996.
Police find illegal firearms factory in jungles in Suriyawewa in the south of Sri Lanka, which allegedly manufacturing weapons for last 12 years, security sources say.
No word on crew of the refugee ship Misen, which was attacked by Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebels earlier this week, security sources say.
